SSD.note: Names no rule or authority on AI harms; the Juba consultation is on hate speech generally.

facts.fact: Go Girl ICT Initiative, led by executive director Eva Yayi Mawa, is leading research under the YoGage AI project on Juba Arabic, and says dialectal variation and inconsistent pronunciation make it hard to standardize a training dataset.

The consultation is on hate speech, with no named digital law or policy put to it.
